text: On October 23, 2019, the Committee of Adjustment Toronto and East York Panel refused the application for minor variances for the property municipally known as 49 Glenholme Avenue (the "Application"). The Notice of Decision is attached to this Motion. The property is located south of St. Clair Avenue West and west of Oakwood Avenue. It is currently occupied by a detached dwelling and is a through lot with frontage on both Glenholme Avenue and Springmount Avenue. The Application seeks to convert the detached garage at the rear of the existing detached dwelling into a residential dwelling unit by constructing a one-storey side addition and by altering the roof over the existing portion of the building.
